undergraduates.label: Undergraduate enrollment
undergraduates.definition: IPEDS fall undergraduate full- and part-time headcount; reporting institution boundary.

non_distance_undergraduates.label: Undergraduates taking non-distance courses
non_distance_undergraduates.definition: Undergraduate headcount less exclusively distance-education students; physical-addressability proxy, not residents.

on_campus_residents.label: On-campus resident students
on_campus_residents.definition: Verified undergraduate residents in university-owned/operated housing; capacity is not occupancy.

age_18_24_pct.label: Undergraduates age 18–24
age_18_24_pct.definition: Sum of 18–19, 20–21 and 22–24 undergraduate age bins divided by all-age undergraduate count.

women_pct.label: Reported undergraduate women share
women_pct.definition: IPEDS reported women / undergraduate total. Disabled by default; client supplies an appropriate target. Not gender identity.

out_of_state_freshmen_pct.label: Domestic out-of-state first-time entrants
out_of_state_freshmen_pct.definition: US first-time entrants minus in-state entrants / all first-time entrants. Not all-undergraduate mix.

age_18_19_pct.label: Age 18–19
age_18_19_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

age_20_21_pct.label: Age 20–21
age_20_21_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

age_22_24_pct.label: Age 22–24
age_22_24_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

age_25_plus_pct.label: Age 25+
age_25_plus_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

age_unknown_pct.label: Age unknown
age_unknown_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

in_state_freshmen_pct.label: In-state first-time entrants
in_state_freshmen_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

international_pct.label: International/nonresident share
international_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

hispanic_pct.label: Hispanic share
hispanic_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

black_pct.label: Black share
black_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

asian_pct.label: Asian share
asian_pct.definition: Descriptive IPEDS undergraduate percentage (residency fields refer only to first-time entrants). Disabled by default.

greek_pct.label: Greek-life undergraduate participation
greek_pct.definition: University-published undergraduate participation, or same-period members/undergraduates from one report. Full-time-only denominators are labeled.

greek_chapters.label: Recognized FSL organizations
greek_chapters.definition: Office-published recognized FSL ecosystem count. Scope may include professional/cultural groups; bounds and broader definitions are labeled.

greek_members.label: Greek community membership
greek_members.definition: Reported membership; never divide by a different-year enrollment to invent participation.

verified_creators_per_1000.label: Verified active creators per 1,000 undergraduates
verified_creators_per_1000.definition: Deduplicated public student creator census under docs/CREATORS.md. No audited census yet.

creator_program_present.label: Documented student content program
creator_program_present.definition: Official evidence of a student content program or campus-specific university-advertised student content role. Advertised opportunities are qualified and discounted; no filled position or current creator roster is implied. A weak recruitment-infrastructure proxy, not creator density. Unknown is not zero.

relevant_awards_pct.label: Relevant bachelor awards share
relevant_awards_pct.definition: Relevant first-major bachelor awards / all first-major bachelor awards; selected six-digit CIP codes, not current enrollment.

relevant_awards.label: Relevant bachelor awards
relevant_awards.definition: First-major bachelor awards in business, communications, media technology, design/fashion, film/photo and sports management; overlapping prefixes deduplicated.

relevant_clubs.label: Verified relevant student organizations
relevant_clubs.definition: Deduplicated audited directory subset with names in evidence note. Lower bound on relevant organizations; not proof of active members.

customers_per_1000.label: Active customers per 1,000 undergraduates
customers_per_1000.definition: Client-specific, same-window deduplicated active customers / campus undergraduates; school match methodology required.

lodging_proxy_usd.label: Federal lodging allowance benchmark
lodging_proxy_usd.definition: Equal-month average FY2027 GSA lodging allowance for matched campus ZIP. Proxy only; not a hotel quote.

labor_hourly_usd.label: Local activation labor hourly rate
labor_hourly_usd.definition: Verified local occupation wage or dated vendor quote with occupation and scope specified.

venue_day_usd.label: Verified venue day cost
venue_day_usd.definition: Comparable dated venue quote for standard activation; event size and inclusions required.

permit_days.label: Published permitting lead time
permit_days.definition: Published campus commercial-activation lead time; not a subjective difficulty rating.

travel_quote_usd.label: Verified travel cost per trip
travel_quote_usd.definition: Dated quote with origin, campaign dates, traveler count and baggage/ground transport scope.

meals_proxy_usd.label: Federal meals/incidental allowance
meals_proxy_usd.definition: GSA administrative benchmark, reported separately from verified activation costs.

airport_km.label: Nearest scheduled-service airport distance
airport_km.definition: Haversine distance to US medium/large airport with scheduled_service=yes; not road distance, fare or route availability.

metro_presence.label: Metropolitan-area membership
metro_presence.definition: IPEDS CBSATYPE=1. Does not measure metro population or proximity to downtown.

nearby_campuses.label: Nearby reference-universe campuses
nearby_campuses.definition: Other fixed reference campuses within 200 km great-circle; cohort-defined cluster opportunity.

cac_usd.label: Campaign customer acquisition cost
cac_usd.definition: Comparable campaign spend / incremental acquired customers, with attribution window and client ID.

conversion_pct.label: Campaign conversion rate
conversion_pct.definition: 100 * attributed new customers / eligible measured leads; sum numerators and denominators across comparable campaigns.

roi_pct.label: Campaign contribution ROI
roi_pct.definition: 100 * (attributable contribution margin minus activation spend) / activation spend; not gross revenue ROAS.

engagement_pct.label: Qualified engagement rate
engagement_pct.definition: 100 * qualified engagements / observed impressions, using consistent platform definitions.

samples.label: Samples distributed
samples.definition: First-party campaign outcome with client, campaign, dates, attribution and denominator definitions. Stored without automatic scoring.

leads.label: Qualified leads
leads.definition: First-party campaign outcome with client, campaign, dates, attribution and denominator definitions. Stored without automatic scoring.

revenue_usd.label: Attributed revenue
revenue_usd.definition: First-party campaign outcome with client, campaign, dates, attribution and denominator definitions. Stored without automatic scoring.

ambassador_conversions.label: Ambassador-attributed conversions
ambassador_conversions.definition: First-party campaign outcome with client, campaign, dates, attribution and denominator definitions. Stored without automatic scoring.

event_attendance.label: Verified event attendance
event_attendance.definition: First-party campaign outcome with client, campaign, dates, attribution and denominator definitions. Stored without automatic scoring.
